ائتلقن (form VIII)
# اِئْتَلَقْنَ (iʔtalaqna) /iʔ.ta.laq.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِئْتَلَقَ (iʔtalaqa)
# اِئْتَلِقْنَ (iʔtaliqna) /iʔ.ta.liq.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِئْتَلَقَ (iʔtalaqa)
